scope: Literal byte-interval/count/witness/selector expectations. Not full v3 language cases, native pack or observed tokenizer outputs; real84case corpus remains independently frozen.

vectors.purpose: Widths2/3/4 and mixed; priority selectors share one boundary without repeated prefix sampling.
Completing a scalar begun in the prior piece does not satisfy mixed.
A separate complete ASCII scalar within the piece qualifies after a carried scalar.
Repeated complete widths count once; one boundary increments multiple matrix rows.
Empty pieces remain in arrays/counts and prefix take; they are not candidate boundaries.
Later eligible boundaries increase counts, while first selection stays the first ordinal.
Generation/semantic/harness exclusions are declarations, not observed membership filters.
Known later evidence is only a lower bound when an earlier population ledger is missing.
Excluded missing ledger remains QCunknown; coverage contribution is declared zero, overall case QC false.
Missing final byte cannot be normalized into known zero boundary counts.
Synthetic EOG/out-of-range labels invalidate eligible ledgers before geometry.
Do not silently sort caller cases into favorable selector order.
Duplicate ordinal is a descriptor error, not an ordering fallback.
Measured success/failure must never become a population selection switch.
Wholly contained three/four-byte scalars are both mixed witnesses before a two-byte pending tail.
